checks.command: pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run typecheck && pnpm --dir services/dsh run typecheck
checks.proves: Field runtime/shared work-center/navigation code remains type-safe.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove device links, stale assignment or accessibility.
checks.passCriteria: Commands exit zero on the resulting SHA and targeted tests added by the unit pass through canonical test entry points.
checks.failCriteria: Any type/test failure or missing required targeted test fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: exercise work queue, refresh, reassignment/stale task, offline pending state, invalid/valid initial and resumed deep links, back navigation, large text and TalkBack on a physical field device.
checks.proves: Field work entry/navigation is usable and fail-closed under real lifecycle conditions.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not close partner/client publication or finance.
checks.passCriteria: All applicable cases converge to authorized current work with explicit recovery and accessible controls.
checks.failCriteria: Unauthorized/stale action, blank/stranded route, hidden pending state or accessibility blocker fails.
